cards.native_editable_derivation: scripts/opera_boxing_surface.gd and scripts/opera_boxing_contact.gd; original PNGs untouched
cards.method: Declared local input-driven whole-image translation, rotation and uniform reach scale. No part isolation, deformation, redrawing, temporal pixel synthesis, frame replacement or new model.
cards.aseprite: Not applicable: no pixel/cel editing or new atlas export; preserve existing sources and use the native GDScript motion/contact master.
cards.fixed: Camera, painted room, glove contours, handedness, cuff identity and texture pixels; no 3D assets, lights or inference.
cards.runtime: 1280x720 base stage; Mobile/Speedy; same coordinates after Canvas transform on supported aspects. Existing 512-square textures.
cards.tolerances: Contact uses declared padded circles anchored at (0.49,0.43) of each whole glove. Radius=0.34*draw side. Analytic first-contact residual <0.005 canvas pixel in seeded native tests; clamps split exactly. Required press bays >=110px.

limits.scope: This single requested engine/test task. No generation batch or funded allowance supplied; stop if art changes become necessary.

attempts: Native stress-01 exposed long-sweep scalar precision; repaired coefficients without loosening the test.
Native stress-04/05 exposed stopped audio playback retirement at process exit; explicit cancellation and mixer-boundary wait retain clean stress-06/07.
Current source has zero generation calls and zero pixel edits; all earlier failed evidence retained.
cards.events: Surface emits accepted work through the existing career owner only; no direct score/save writes. One attack resolves once before synchronous callbacks.
cards.interruptions: Release and normal phase completion clear input and attack ownership while preserving earned one-shot feedback. Explicit cancel, pause, focus loss, hide, close and tree exit also stop owned sounds; interrupted work never pays.
cards.stop_fallback: A failed contact, ownership, passive or save invariant blocks publication; preserve the counterexample and repair only its cause. Do not replace missing art with a generation campaign.

cards.intention: The child positions a padded glove to intercept a shot or extends it into the visible training target.
cards.required_action: Stable owned glove follows direct tablet input or phone edge relative drag, can hold/cross/retract and make actual padded contact.
cards.entry_exit: Lower glove bay to deliberate contact, then a latched strike or held guard; release returns safely to its own bay.
cards.timeline: Respond on input. Contact sweeps each delivered pointer segment; returning gloves sweep each rendered interval. A new strike requires >=40px forward travel and real padding overlap. Return uses existing exponential settle.
cards.geometry: Whole authored glove; side=168*(0.92+0.38*clamped reach), radius=0.34*side. Split at reach=0/1. Phone relative gain=(2.4,1.15).
cards.reuse_gap: Existing independent glove pair covers this engine test. Richer authored acting/material acceptance remains separate; no pixel work commissioned.

cards.intention: A floating padded hand telegraphs, approaches the child, deflects on glove contact and reveals an opportunity to counter.
cards.required_action: Visible incoming hand and collision share the complete path. Held or moving guards work anywhere before player contact; missed contact is harmless.
cards.entry_exit: Windup at (0.43/0.57w,0.20h), flight to (0.46/0.54w,0.86h). Deflect once, hands open to the mitt; a fresh counter earns a unit. No whole imp body.
cards.timeline: Guard drill:0.8s windup plus2.4s flight. Imp:1.4s initial taunt,1.15s windup (assist+0.45),0.9s flight,1.7s opening (assist+0.5). Blocks open immediately. No catch-up multi-award loop.
cards.geometry: Linear flight and radius=160*(0.78+0.25*progress)*0.34; closed/open hands remain whole source images. Actual incoming contact latches before callbacks.
cards.reuse_gap: Existing approved-source glove pair reused for owner-requested floating hands. Opponent-specific appearance and motion acceptance are still pending, not inferred from player art approval.
